messages:
Sam Patel: Attaching Zephyr POC pen-test zip and CSV mapping. High level: 4 findings - 2 critical (JWT replay + public S3 object), 1 high (old dependency), 1 medium (verbose error). Need remediation plan for vendor risk intake.

Jin Park: Got it. Will own authenticated rescan and verification. Quick plan: re-run auth scan, verify nonce header, confirm S3 ACLs.

Priya Desai: Legal needs interim artifacts by EOD tomorrow. Must include PR links, deploy timestamps, and raw scan outputs for SIG intake.

Alex Gomez: I can push ACL and rotate keys today. JWT nonce fix will be a small patch; target canary deploy tomorrow morning.

Sam Patel: Owners: Alex (infra + keys), Jin (scan/verif), Sam (vendor binder + comms). Proposed timeline: interim artifacts 2025-12-02, canary deploy 2025-12-03, prod deploy 2025-12-04.

sec-bot: Auto-mapped: PT-901 -> CVE-JWT-2025 (critical); PT-902 -> S3-ACL-EXPOSED (critical). Created tickets.

Alex Gomez: PR #4120 (ACL + rotation) opened. PR #4125 (auth nonce) in draft. Linking after CI.

Jin Park: Interim scan uploaded: gs://internal/zephyr/pt-interim-1887654321.xml (sha256: d1f2...). S3 issue cleared in canary, JWT still reproducible on legacy endpoint.

Priya Desai: Good. Make sure interim bundle includes brief verification steps for the SIG questionnaire.

Sam Patel: Draft binder uploaded: binder_zephyr_2025-12-02.pdf. Sent read-only link to vendor risk.

Alex Gomez: PR #4125 merged and deployed to prod-canary 2025-12-03T09:10Z. Will monitor and push prod on 2025-12-04 morning.

Jin Park: Final re-scan completed and uploaded: gs://internal/zephyr/pt-final-1887654321.xml. Both criticals now show as remediated. Attached checklist and smoke-test logs.

Priya Desai: Vendor risk confirmed binder accepted for SIG/CAIQ. Closing note to vendor portal scheduled.

Sam Patel: Closing loop — final artifacts linked to tickets and binder. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
